snippet.title: Magic Gear - Help pacifist agent Pax rescue her allies and deactivate the terrifying Magic Gear!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://r-goulart.itch.io/magic-gear?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt When a mysterious mechanical base rises in the forest and a group of tactical magical girls is captured, the mission falls to the focused and pacifist Pax. With her advanced infiltration and immobilization techniques, she will face any challenge to deactivate the Magic Gear, the heart of the base. The mission is of critical importance. The future of peace... and her general's lasagna, depend on it.
